description: Run ordered optical commands under one workspace lock. Supply an optional starting revision. Mutations inherit the current step revision. Stop at the first error; rollback defaults to true. History, workspace control, capabilities and nested batch commands are excluded.
name: batch

description: Read the saved free-space laser bench and shared project revision. Table XY; Z height; mm; rotations [roll,pitch,yaw] in degrees.
name: bench_get

description: Get a read-only two-arm laser bench example. Nothing is saved until bench_set or system_set.
name: bench_example

description: Atomically save a free-space bench at the current shared project revision. Stage members use fixed reference poses and translate along a unit table-frame axis by position_mm + pzt.value_um/1000. Set travel in mm and the optional PZT range in um. Staged benches return a fresh trace. Other elements with omitted or null rotation require bench_auto_aim before saving. Branches use output from, input to, and optional intermediate output selections via.
name: bench_set

description: Trace the saved bench or supplied draft without writing. Nearest surface/mount hits, optional intended port connections, ideal thin lenses and lens_group instances of the current prescription, bounded ray trees and complete power accounting. A lens_group position is its first vertex; local +X is prescription +Z. Groups require forward refractive positive-gap prescriptions with air at both boundaries; their scalar transmittance is applied once. Splitters may set index for polarization-averaged Fresnel splitting; mirrors and splitters may carry a thin-film coating stack. Mirrors, splitters and thin lenses may scatter (lambertian or ABg) into deterministic hemisphere samples; scattered power leaves the specular child. Group ghosts enumerate internal Fresnel bounces (0-2) per surface; shares beyond the bounce budget are truncated to conserve power, and ghost segments skip internal obstruction checks. Detectors with pixels record irradiance maps. Physical segments record ports, media, wavelength and OPL and link to their preceding segment by index. Named branches aggregate on-axis specular paths between their declared ports. Jones polarization drives waveplates, polarizers and PBS outputs. Curved mirrors use a paraxial focusing reflection. The geometric ledger adds branch powers incoherently.
name: bench_trace

description: Read assembly coordinates, surface normals, holes/offsets, mounts, BOM and clearance diagnostics from the saved bench or supplied draft. Missing hardware is unresolved. No writes.
name: bench_assembly

description: Search representative lab optics and mounting assemblies. Includes model parameters, clamping metadata and approximate planning prices.
name: bench_catalog

description: Preview a mounted lab bench template. Set apply=true with the current revision to save it as the project bench.
name: bench_template

description: Solve omitted or null rotations and rotations with aim_rotation=true. Stage rotations are fixed; source directions are adjustable with aim_direction=true. Align two incident branches at each combiner using a shared reflected/transmitted output. Both separation measures must be below 1e-6 in mm and mrad. Residuals are relative to the first incoming branch. On conflict, return ok=false, the input ports, and the original bench. Optional hole snapping and uniform Z move elements outside stages. Set apply=true with the current revision to save a successful result.
name: bench_auto_aim

description: Review optical terminations, Gaussian aperture clearance, mount collisions and hole access. Evaluate equal_opl as the first named branch minus the second in mm or um. Evaluate colinear at a common splitter, returning spot separation in mm and output angular separation in mrad. The assertion unit selects which measure is compared with target and tolerance. Recommends dump positions for escaped beams. Set require_pass=true to fail the command when the check reports errors.
name: bench_lab_check

description: Read ordered installation steps, expected beam radii, and quarter-turn screw and spot-shift estimates.
name: bench_alignment_guide

description: Return a lab blueprint or alignment SOP with its filename, MIME type and text content.
name: bench_export_blueprint

description: Read the workspace state before requesting optical data. A recovery state is connected but has no active optical system.
name: workspace_status

description: While recovery is active, reread a user-repaired saved file under the current workspace lease. A missing or invalid file stays in recovery. Requires its current recovery revision.
name: workspace_retry

description: While recovery is active, validate a chosen native/Geopter/ZMX project or create a new system. Preserve the original file before installing the chosen system; reject changed disk contents and stale recovery revisions. No optical tool can write through recovery.
name: workspace_recover

description: Read the entire current optical prescription and revision
name: system_get

description: Atomically save the complete prescription; revision must match system_get
name: system_set

description: Validate a complete prescription without changing the workspace
name: system_validate

description: Read the prescription with the active configuration's overrides applied: the exact system every analysis tool evaluates. Read-only; authoring fields stay on system_get
name: system_resolved

description: Select the active multi-configuration by zero-based index and save atomically. All analysis tools then evaluate that configuration. Requires the current revision
name: configuration_activate

description: Stage inserted or removed internal surface rows in a supplied draft without saving, solving or tracing. Zero-based before may equal the row count (before Image). Remaps stop and retained gap references; rejects deletion of gaps referenced by retained solves. Returns the transformed system, old_to_new indices, inserted indices and stop_reassigned.
name: surface_edit

description: High-density optical summary returning first-order metrics, polychromatic per-field RMS spot radii, distortion, axial color, and minimum center/edge thicknesses in one call.
name: design_summary

description: Run the native Damped Least Squares (Levenberg-Marquardt) sequential optical optimizer over chosen variables (radius, thickness, conic, asphere, model glass, tilt/decenter, configuration overrides) and merit function operands (RMS spot, wavefront, EFL, BFL, F/#, track, center/edge thickness, distortion, color, chief ray angle, ray intercept). Set apply=true with the current revision to commit the optimized system atomically; otherwise returns a dry-run preview.
name: optimize

description: Evaluate per-operand plus/minus tolerance sensitivities (radius, thickness, decenter, tilt, index, Abbe, element decenter/tilt) with optional autofocus compensation, sorted by worst offenders plus RSS estimate.
name: tolerance_sensitivity

description: Run parallel seeded Monte Carlo tolerance trials with optional autofocus compensator, returning distribution statistics (mean, std_dev, min/max, p50/p80/p90/p95/p98), pass yield rate, compensator stroke range, and histogram.
name: tolerance_monte_carlo

description: List the in-memory revision history snapshots of the current workspace, including undo/redo availability.
name: history_list

description: Undo the latest workspace mutation by restoring the previous prescription and project link. Requires the current revision.
name: history_undo

description: Redo a previously undone workspace mutation atomically. Requires the current revision.
name: history_redo

description: Restore a historical prescription and project link by its zero-based index from history_list. The restore is undoable and requires the current revision.
name: history_restore

description: Compare two revision history snapshots (default: previous vs current), returning optical metric deltas (EFL, BFL, F/#, RMS spot) and per-surface prescription diffs.
name: history_compare

description: List the active linked project file, saved projects in the workspace projects directory, and recent project paths.
name: project_list

description: Open a native Hissabeth JSON or ZMX project file from disk, validate it, link native JSON files for subsequent saves, and update recent projects. Requires the current revision.
name: project_open

description: Atomically save the current prescription as Hissabeth JSON and link future saves to it. Relative paths resolve inside the workspace projects directory. Use project_export for ZMX. Requires the current revision.
name: project_save_as

description: List qualified product_catalog keys for built-in and project glass catalogs
name: materials_list

description: Search catalog metadata; wavelengths in metadata are micrometers
name: material_search

description: Compute refractive index at wavelength nm with environmental corrections
name: material_index

description: Compute absolute air index from wavelength nm, temperature C and pressure Pa
name: air_index

description: Parse an AGF catalog and replace that named project catalog, preserving all other catalogs
name: catalog_import

description: Get global 3D ray paths for stored fields, including explicit trace rejection reasons
name: layout

description: Inspect a normalized pupil ray or a finite source XY / (dx/dz,dy/dz) launch with positive initial z direction; return partial paths and physical failures. Pupil rays use saved mapping and vignetting; object rays use the actual curved source without pupil aiming.
name: trace_inspect

description: Per-vertex linearized axial and stored-field chief ray tables in global x/y; signed reduced angles include centered reflections. No aperture clipping. The image row uses its vertex plane.
name: paraxial_trace

description: Continuous radial field sweep of analytic sagittal/tangential chief-ray foci for every stored wavelength, including zero weights and duplicates. Default endpoint is +Y at the maximum stored field radius; optional field_end selects a 2D slice. Shifts reference the stored image vertex; retain per-branch failures.
name: field_curvature

description: Assemble selected saved-prescription sections as structured tables and the same canonical text. Includes endpoints, first-order/cardinal quantities, actual media, signed gaps, profiles and gap relations. Per-cell errors preserve other data; no sections returns header only. Does not mutate the system.
name: prescription_report

description: Compute first-order matrix, focal lengths, image conjugate, magnification and pupils. Afocal systems retain defined quantities; absent finite focal lengths, image conjugate and working F-number are null.
name: paraxial

description: Trace x/y in pupil mm, normalized by the wavelength's paraxial entrance-pupil radius using the saved pupil mapping; stored field_index or arbitrary field/field_x
name: trace_ray

description: Trace a grid or hexapolar pupil quadrature; report area-weighted centroid/RMS, geometric radius and rejected-ray counts
name: spot_diagram

description: Area- and spectrum-weighted spot diagram for positive-weight wavelengths, retaining lateral color and sampled transmission
name: polychromatic_spot

description: Geometric MTF from a complex OTF sum over weighted real intercepts on one physical frequency grid; selected or weighted wavelengths
name: geometric_mtf

description: Field-local tangential/sagittal transverse ray aberrations relative to chief ray in mm
name: ray_fan

description: Field-local tangential/sagittal optical path difference relative to chief reference sphere, in waves
name: opd_fan

description: Longitudinal spherical aberration as axis intercept versus pupil radius
name: longitudinal_aberration

description: Longitudinal spherical aberration for every stored wavelength
name: spherochromatism

description: Differential sagittal/tangential focal positions about the chief ray
name: astigmatism

description: Actual chief image intercept relative to the paraxial chief intercept at the stored image plane
name: distortion

description: Masked pupil wavefront map, RMS and peak-to-valley in waves
name: wavefront

description: Unit-energy Fraunhofer diffraction intensity and sampled Strehl ratio; paraxial exit pupil mapping
name: diffraction_psf

description: Field-local diffraction MTF from a complex OTF sum at common physical frequencies, with spectral/transmission weights and real-chief lateral color
name: diffraction_mtf

description: Geometric encircled energy about the transmitted-ray centroid
name: encircled_energy

description: Least-squares Noll Zernike decomposition of the traced pupil wavefront; unit-RMS disk normalization, coefficients in waves
name: wavefront_zernike

description: Unit-energy PSF from a direct Huygens-Fresnel sum over traced pupil samples at arbitrary image sampling; paraxial exit pupil mapping
name: huygens_psf

description: Field-local diffraction MTF from the direct Huygens PSF with the same complex OTF composition as the FFT path
name: huygens_mtf

description: Paraxial Gaussian beam q-parameter propagation through the reduced system matrix: per-surface 1/e^2 radii plus image-plane waist, curvature, Rayleigh range and divergence. Input waist_z is the global z of the input waist (first vertex at 0). Unclipped, unaberrated, on-axis
name: gaussian_beam

description: Gaussian overlap coupling efficiency at the stored image plane from the propagated beam into a flat-phase fiber mode of given mode field diameter; also reports the optimum MFD and its efficiency. No offsets, tilt or aberration
name: fiber_coupling

description: Paraxial image focus shift across a wavelength interval
name: chromatic_focus

description: Evaluate radial sag and its first derivative, including even and odd terms
name: surface_sag

description: Set final image distance to the finite or infinite conjugate paraxial focus
name: autofocus

description: Store a persistent gap solve and recalculate all constraints atomically. Fixed removes the relationship and retains thickness. Indices are zero-based; overall length sums the half-open gap interval [first,last)
name: solve

description: Recalculate all saved gap constraints atomically and return their definitions and resolved thicknesses
name: solve_recalculate

description: Reference-wavelength drawing envelopes from chief and four field-local pupil rim rays, ignoring physical clipping; includes reached prefixes and geometric failures
name: aperture_report

description: Compute four global-axis aperture boundaries per field, store directional vignetting factors, and resolve gap constraints atomically at the reference wavelength
name: vignetting_update

description: Replace the saved project with a minimum blank prescription: one plane air stop, unclipped plane endpoints, infinity source, one on-axis field, d-line and a 10 mm entrance pupil. Clears prior project data. Requires the current revision; creation is atomic and resolves the new model before saving.
name: project_new

description: Import native or Geopter project text and atomically replace current prescription
name: project_import

description: Export the current prescription as native or Geopter JSON text
name: project_export

description: Describe all implemented tools and physical scope
name: capabilities
